result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback position: affiliates remain covered without even requiring written notice, and the licence is transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction. It also adds the preferred contractor-use right. The edits are targeted and preserve the location, fee, exclusivity, and use restrictions. It does not reach the full preferred position because it does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach.
